items.name: Comedian Chris Cope (Jimmy Kimmel, Don't Tell Comedy, Conan) Headlines The Riot Houston
items.caption:
The Conan and Jimmy Kimmel Live comic returns with material built for late-night crowds.
Chris Cope performs at The Riot Comedy Club on January 24, 2027. His credits also include Don't Tell Comedy. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
